audience: clinic teams with authorized Feegow API access

useCases.title: Review the clinic agenda
useCases.text: Find appointments in a selected date range and see their booking status. Only connect patient data you are authorized to process with your AI service.

useCases.title: Find available appointment times
useCases.text: Check the available times for a procedure or specialty before choosing a booking time.

useCases.title: Book an appointment
useCases.text: Create a booking after checking availability. Clinic automation may notify the patient by SMS, email or WhatsApp.

useCases.title: Reschedule a booking
useCases.text: Move an appointment to a new time with a reason. The old slot is released and clinic automation may notify the patient.

useCases.title: Review clinic invoices
useCases.text: Read receivable or payable invoices for a selected date range. This tool does not collect or send payments.
